html:
The half-brother of Amilcar Cabral and the first president of Guinea-Bissau, from 1974 until he was overthrown in November 1980.

A founder of the PAIGC, he governed with the plan of uniting Guinea-Bissau and Cape Verde. Many Guineans resented the weight of Cape Verdeans in the party and state, and the economy struggled. On 14 November 1980 Nino Vieira removed him in a coup, after which Cape Verde split off and the union plan ended. Cabral was jailed, then went into exile in Cuba and Portugal, where he died.
